meta.standard: WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text (>=24px, or >=18.66px at weight >=700)
meta.method: TreeWalker over every text node; computed colour composited over the nearest opaque ancestor background; alpha layers composited in order over white
meta.limitations: nodes whose backdrop is an image or gradient - on the element itself or on its ::before/::after - are reported as indeterminate rather than assigned a guessed ratio; duplicate selector+colour+size+text combinations are counted once. An earlier revision checked only element backgrounds and therefore reported the home hero as near-white-on-near-white; a screenshot showed white text on a dark Unsplash photo painted by section.hero-section::before, so pseudo-element backdrops are now detected. Indeterminate means unverified, not passing: those nodes still need manual review.
meta.themeControl: localStorage foodstory_dark_mode and foodstory-theme set before navigation; the applied documentElement.dataset.theme is recorded per run so a theme that failed to apply is visible rather than silent
